status: Seat arrangement from the Polish Osa-AK manual's cabin plan (mon_2112_80 Fig. 3, pp. 23–25), confirmed by WZU camera views of a Polish crew at work (grezicki_wzu Fig. 4): driver front left, commander front right, the three operators on one bench along the left wall facing the main console SŁ-2M, front to rear guidance (deputy commander), search (senior operator), range (operator). The operator panels are SAM Simulator's photographs of the three columns (samsim_panels), at 1 mm per pixel: every control, lamp and screen sits where it is in those photos, cross-checked against real-cabin photos (cabin_photos) and the game's sprite positions. Distances between seats, the columns' height above the floor and the controls the game has no picture for are SAM3D estimates that only need to be reachable and readable. Lamp meanings follow the SAM Simulator manual where it gives them.
notes: Body frame: metres, x right, y forward, z up, from the ground under the hull centre. The placeholder hull in Unreal is 9.1 x 2.8 m with its roof at 2.2 m. Lamp sources use the source ids of data/procedures/osa_ak.json. Red dots (red_dot) are only given where a picture shows one: they mark a control's working position, not where it starts (docs/research/OSA_CONSOLE_MAP_2026-10.md §12).

walk.notes: The aisle behind the operators' bench (its edge at x = -0.514; docs/OSA_INTERIOR_HOLISTIC.md section 28) and in front of the right-hand racks SP-1M and SP-2M (their faces at x = 0.56-0.61), from the operator's seat to the step of the raised area under the cab seats (mon_2112_80 Fig. 3; docs/OSA_INTERIOR_HOLISTIC.md section 24). Standing eye: under the roof lining at 2.10 m (tools/blender/build_cabin_interior.py ROOF_Z) a crewman stoops. SAM3D estimate.
Past the operator's seat towards the rear, beside the CGW-10P box on the floor (x -0.1 to 0.1) and clear of the 0096 cabinet. SAM3D estimate.

Over the raised area's after part and through the gap between the driver's and the commander's seats, to the gear lever. The walk has one floor height, so a crewman crossing the after part (y 2.6-3.42) stands in the deck there. SAM3D estimate.

panels.label: SOC / SSC azimuth (senior operator)
panels.notes: Middle column of SŁ-2M, top to bottom (mon_2112_80 Fig. 3; cabin_photos): lamp row 0094-9, search indicator OP81-16M with its switches either side of the scope, OP63-6M2, azimuth block OS52-12M with the hand wheel on the right, OK81-4M-I. Positions from the game's photo of this column (samsim_panels, 1 mm per pixel). The readout strip across the top (0094-5) is eight round amber-lit digit counters in a pale window (opisybroni 54539; user_modernised_2, where the unit is unchanged); its printed captions (ΔД, Δε, АЗИМУТ ССЦ, УГОЛ МЕСТА ССЦ, СВР I, II) are not drawn, the digits are placeholders.

ВЫСОК., ПЕРЕДАТЧИК, РАБОТА / КОНТРОЛЬ / КАЛИБР., ЦЕЛЬ), OK62-5M, OS61-5M (СДЦ / ШТ., wind compensation), range block OS81-18M (АВТОМАТ, ПОЛУАВТОМАТ, ТСЦ, РУЧНОЕ, range window, hand wheel), 0051-7M. The plates are readable in the game photo. Positions from the game's photo of this column (samsim_panels, 1 mm per pixel).

panels.label: Rack SŁ-1M with the gyro panel 0005-8M (deputy commander)
panels.notes: Height (9 Nov 2026): top at 1.65 m, about +-0.05, not level with SŁ-2M as Fig. 3's row schematic draws it: from the R-123Ms posed against the racks in g090-a and g091-b/d, and the horizon in g082-b (docs/OSA_INTERIOR_HOLISTIC.md section 22). Rack SŁ-1M on the left wall ahead of the main console, beside the driver's seat (mon_2112_80 Fig. 3 (plan and wall views of the 9A33BM2, scaled from SŁ-2M = 1.89 m, about 4.7 mm per pixel of the extracted drawing)): rear column 0004-12M (two rows) over OK81-4M-II, front column 0005-8M (gyro panel), OS51-8M, 0009-5M; top level with SŁ-2M. rwd_mb3 9a33_51/52 show the same blocks. Blocks and parts traced from wwp_gecko g091-a through the joint solve (1.275 x 0.554 m), the drawing g091-c telling each part; modelled as SM_SL1MFace. The orientation controls stand on the photo's parts; which part is which control is SAM3D's reading of the captions.

panels.label: Rack SŁ-3M (power blocks)
panels.notes: Rack SŁ-3M on the left wall behind the main console (mon_2112_80 Fig. 3 (plan and wall views of the 9A33BM2, scaled from SŁ-2M = 1.89 m, about 4.7 mm per pixel of the extracted drawing)): 0093-28, 0092-10M, 0096-10M (rear column), 0092-8, OS94-10, 0092-4M (front column). Size and height through the joint solve (wwp_gecko g099-a, b: 1.234 x 0.551 m against Fig. 3's 1.33 x 0.65), layout from the book's drawing g099-c; its x kept at the cabin's aisle, its aft end set 5 mm off the bulkhead. Modelled as SM_SL3MFace.

panels.label: SSC elevation / TOV / launch (deputy commander)
panels.notes: Front column of SŁ-2M, top to bottom (mon_2112_80 Fig. 3; cabin_photos): meter block 0004-14M (four ε/β meters, not modelled), TV monitor WPU-44 with the round elevation-search indicator OS81-10M to its right (not modelled yet; space left in the photo position), launch block 0004-11M (КАНАЛЫ button groups, numbered ИЗДЕЛИЯ list and selector, РОД РАБОТЫ, the ДЦ meter (labelled ДЦ in the game photo), the guarded АВАРИЙНЫЙ ПУСК), elevation block OS52-14M1 (hand wheel on the right), OK51-6M. Positions from the game's photo of this column (samsim_panels, 1 mm per pixel). The four meters of 0004-14M are white-faced with black cases (opisybroni 54334; user_modernised_2: faces about 0.075 x 0.058 m, 0.1 m pitch); the dial scale is generic.

panels.label: Rack SP-1M
panels.notes: Height (9 Nov 2026): top at 1.65 m, about +-0.05, not level with SŁ-2M as Fig. 3's row schematic draws it: from the R-123Ms posed against the racks in g090-a and g091-b/d, and the horizon in g082-b (docs/OSA_INTERIOR_HOLISTIC.md section 22). Right wall, ahead of SP-2M, beside the commander (mon_2112_80 Fig. 3 section A-A (plan and wall views of the 9A33BM2, scaled from SŁ-2M = 1.89 m)): two columns, front 0093-14A over OK82-2M over 0092-9M, rear 0093-19 over the double-height 0065-2M; the spare-parts box ZCzZ1A nr 2 below it. Face 0.787 m from the centreline. Blocks and parts traced from the drawing wwp_gecko g090-b (1.275 x 0.552 m, the width taken from SŁ-1M), checked against the photo g090-a; modelled as SM_SP1MFace. No control of this rack is worked in the game.

panels.label: Rack SP-2M (computer 9S456)
panels.notes: Right wall across the aisle from SŁ-2M (mon_2112_80 Fig. 3 section A-A): three columns of five blocks, OR95-1M..OR-15M, OR-31M..OR-13M, and four OK52-15M over OS52-16M, OK52-17M, 0091-17M, 0091-18; flak11 and rwd_mb3 put the 9S456 computer here. Face 0.612 m from the centreline. Traced from wwp_gecko p. 92-93 (tools/blender/sp2m_trace.py): the face 1.89 m wide (SŁ-2M's width, the scale) by 1.24 m measured, its top under the roof rail as before; the mesh SM_SP2M2Face carries its blocks and parts. Drawn only (station nominal).

panels.label: Rack SP-3M-2 (IFF, power)
panels.notes: Right wall behind SP-2M (mon_2112_80 Fig. 3 section A-A: 0094-11M, 12RZM and 6RZM-2 over 7RZM, 3RZM, 2RZM-2 and 4RZM-2). Traced from wwp_gecko p. 98 (g098-b, c through the joint solve; tools/blender/sp3m_trace.py): 1.24 x 0.57 m from the white panel's corner to the drawer's frame and the blocks' foot, against Fig. 3's 1.31 x 0.61; its aft end set against the bulkhead (the solve's own bulkhead lies 0.09 m further aft than the cabin's), so its centre is 0.11 m aft of SL-3M's. The instrument blocks stand 147.6 mm behind the face plane; the mesh SM_SP3MFace carries them. Which block is which name is Fig. 3's left-to-right order, an assumption. Drawn only (station nominal).

displays.label: SOC indicator
displays.notes: Search picture up to 45 km on the selected scale, with the SSC azimuth line and range gate the operator puts on the target mark (p22). Sweep period, afterglow, the 10-45 km scale drawn as a delayed sweep (centre = 10 km), the clutter disc and the gate marker are SAM3D estimates.

displays.label: Range indicator
displays.notes: Two sweeps: the upper shows 0-28 km with the target as a spike, the lower a 1.5 km magnification around the range gates. The counter shows the range wheel (p24 item 2). Sweeps appear 1 min after switching on, and the radar picture only with РАБОТА selected (voenizdat_osa_1991 p98–100, Fig. 2.36).

displays.label: βс
displays.notes: SSC azimuth in Russian military angle (60-00 = 360 deg); ПОДСВЕТКА lights it. Dial face: SAM3D estimate.

displays.label: SOC/SSC readout strip
displays.source: docs/research/OSA_MANUALS_2026-10.md (the strip: ΔД, Δε, β and ε of the tracking radar); cabin_photos (opisybroni 54539); cabin_photos (user_modernised_2 (eight counters); captions under them include ΔД, Δε, АЗИМУТ ССЦ, УГОЛ МЕСТА ССЦ, СВР I, II)
displays.notes: Left to right: ΔД (metres between the range gate and the echo in it), Δε (mils between the antenna's elevation and the echo's), the SSC azimuth rough then fine counter, the SSC elevation rough then fine counter, and the two СВР (missile channel) places, not read yet. Angles are in mils (6000 to the circle, XX-YY; samsim_osa p16): rough = the hundreds, fine = the rest. Which counter reads what, and what exactly the deviations are, is our reading of the manual's one-line description and the photographs.

displays.label: TOV monitor
displays.notes: The camera looks along the SSC azimuth and elevation with the wide or narrow lens; crosshair at the centre.

displays.label: εс
displays.notes: SSC elevation in Russian military angle (15-00 = 90 deg); ПОДСВЕТКА lights it. Dial face: SAM3D estimate.

displays.label: ДЦ
displays.notes: Measured target distance, 10 V = 10 km. Reads while the SSC tracks in range (the range wheel follows the target then); rests at 0 otherwise. Full scale 30 V: SAM3D estimate.

displays.label: ЗК-4 (Qc)
displays.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p48 (the course setter ЗК-4 has a scale the heading is set on)
displays.notes: Dial face in degrees: SAM3D estimate.

displays.label: OR-31M Qc scale
displays.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p48 (agreement is checked on the Qc scale of block OR-31M, which stops turning once the course setter's and the GA-3's selsyns agree), p52 (OR-31M carries the follow-up systems' scales)
displays.notes: Shows the gyro half-compass's heading, so it turns while the gyro is slaved to the setter and stops when they agree. Dial face in mils (60-00 to the circle): SAM3D estimate. In the window of the OR-31M's middle bezel of three (traced, tools/blender/sp2m_trace.py; which bezel is the Qc scale: SAM3D's choice).

displays.label: ШИРОТА
displays.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p51-52 (potentiometer φ with the scale ШИРОТА on block 0005-8M)
displays.notes: Degrees of latitude, 0-90 over three quarters of a turn: SAM3D estimate of the face.

displays.label: Топливо (fuel)
displays.source: ePap (samsim_thread: about 300 l in the tank; the crew asks for fuel at half)
displays.notes: The tank's level in litres, 0-300 over three quarters of a turn. Its place on the driver's dashboard (one of the stand-in gauge faces) and its face: SAM3D estimates.

displays.label: Elevation-search indicator OS81-10M
displays.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p95 (two-coordinate sector indicator, rectangular raster, brightness mark; 31° of elevation and 2 km of range centred on the tracking radar's range gate; three ranges for search beams I, II, III; the antenna scans in elevation within the beam during ЦУ), Fig. 2.37 p97 (beam I −1° to 5°, II 3° to 9°, III 6° to 30°); samsim_panels (position: the round screen right of the TV monitor)
displays.notes: One raster per search beam of the console's elevation_search (I, II, III), placed as in Fig. 2.37 (approximate); it shows the beam the antenna searches, and the antenna's sweep and target marks come from the engagement model. Afterglow 1.5 s: SAM3D estimate.
